# Phase Three — Deployment and Release Plan

> A commit is only a seed; Awtsmoos.com publication is the fruit. The release closes only when GitHub and the living public route agree on truth.

## Before commit

1. Refresh branch, HEAD, status, and remote.
2. Confirm procedural-core files changed by this mission only.
3. Reread every touched file.
4. Run final critical structural/test/browser gates.
5. Stage explicit related paths only; never `git add .`.
6. Inspect complete staged diff and staged file list.
7. Commit with focused message.

## Concurrent-upstream safety

1. Fetch origin immediately after commit.
2. Compare local commit base to `origin/main`.
3. If upstream moved and primary worktree has unrelated dirt, do not stash/rebase it.
4. Use an isolated worktree/clone from fresh `origin/main`, cherry-pick the verified mission commit, resolve only related conflicts, rerun critical gates.
5. Push only the verified integrated commit chain.
6. Verify GitHub remote SHA with `git ls-remote` or equivalent.

## Deployment discovery already observed

Repository contains `scripts/bhRelease.mjs`, immutable production deploy helpers, local snapshot publication, canonical-server activation, nginx/production authority tooling, and deployment contract tests. This is not assumed to be GitHub Pages.

## Publication gates

- inspect exact current release command/arguments;
- identify how commit/SHA is embedded into the deploy artifact;
- run the repository-supported release mechanism;
- verify deployment reports the intended SHA/version;
- discover actual public route from configuration/output, not memory;
- HTTP-check it directly;
- open in a fresh browser session;
- exercise the universal demo/API and capture runtime/browser evidence.
